name: Write and debug Unity C# game mechanics
description: Users asked to write, modify, or debug C# scripts for Unity and other game engines to implement specific gameplay mechanics, such as collision detection, character movement, scoring, and inventory systems. The requests frequently involved fixing compilation errors, optimizing performance, or adjusting logic in existing code snippets provided by the user.
